name: GOL ~Dakkan~
source:
An incident occurs where the secretary of the Foreign Affairs Vice Minister is kidnapped.

The request for her rescue is conveyed to the ultra-legal private paramilitary group “GOL,” which can operate thanks to guarantees obtained through diplomatic channels. To get the job done, recently graduated from training, Tenjo Akari joins marksmanship expert Courtney and explosives and lock-picking professional Rachel. Under the command of Mesena from cyberspace, the three infiltrate Dinara Castle, where the secretary is being held.

However, the Persona Brothers, who specialize in altering personalities upon request, have already begun abusing the secretary to the point of breaking her will. Due to a minor mistake made by Akari, GOL finds itself in a dire situation.

Akari Amagi is captured and falls into the hands of the tormentors. Will they be able to rescue both the secretary and Akari? The mission to recover both begins...

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20121030172605/http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=41513]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
发生了外交部副部长秘书被绑架的事件。

营救她的请求已转达给超合法的私人准军事组织“GOL”，该组织能够在通过外交渠道获得的保证下运作。为了完成这项工作，刚从培训毕业的天城明里与射击专家考特尼以及炸药和开锁专家雷切尔一起工作。在网络空间梅塞纳的指挥下，三人潜入了关押秘书的迪纳拉城堡。

然而，专门根据要求改变人格的Persona兄弟已经开始对秘书进行虐待，甚至达到了摧毁她意志的程度。由于Akari的一个小错误，GOL陷入了困境。

天城明里被俘并落入施虐者手中。他们能同时营救秘书和明里吗？恢复两者的任务开始了……

[译自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20121030172605/http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=41513]Getchu[/url]]
